identification: WWI Memorial Plaque named ARTHUR EDWARD BATE. Online records (Virtual War Memorial Australia) show Private Arthur Edward Bate, AIF, died of pneumonia on 22 January 1916 at Sydney Hall Hospital, Weymouth, England, buried Greenbank Cemetery, Bristol. So it is an Australian (AIF) plaque.
